# Saginaw Construction

> Drywall and remodeling contractor serving Bend, Oregon and surrounding Central
> Oregon communities. Residential drywall, commercial drywall and remodeling
> construction. Over 30 years in the drywall industry.

Owner and manager: Patrick McElderry
Contact: Patrick@SaginawConstruction.com
Service area: Bend, Redmond, Sisters, Sunriver, La Pine, Prineville, Tumalo, Terrebonne - Oregon

## Services

- Residential Drywall (/services/residential-drywall): Hanging, taping, finishing
  and texture for new homes, additions and repairs. Includes texture matching on
  older homes and repair after water or impact damage.
- Commercial Drywall (/services/commercial-drywall): Tenant improvements, office
  build-outs, retail, restaurant and medical interiors. Fire-rated and sound-rated
  assemblies, Level 4 and Level 5 finishing.
- Remodeling Construction (/services/remodeling-construction): Wall removal, new
  openings, kitchen and bathroom remodels, basement and garage finishing, popcorn
  ceiling removal, texture matching between old and new work.

## Key pages

- Home (/): Overview of services and service area.
- About (/about): Company background and owner experience.
- Projects (/projects): Recent residential, commercial and remodel work.
- Service Areas (/service-areas): Towns served across Central Oregon.
- Reviews (/reviews): Customer reviews, collected via Trustpilot.
- FAQ (/faq): Answers on scope, timelines, texture matching, dust and estimates.
- Contact (/contact): Estimate request form and direct contact details.

## Notes

Values: integrity, quality, speed. Every job is scoped in writing before work
starts. Owner-managed on site.
